# OnePageWebsite — Copilot Instructions

## Project

- This is a small one-page website.
- Preserve the existing design and structure unless I explicitly ask for a change.
- Prefer simple solutions over unnecessary frameworks, libraries, or abstractions.
- Do not create new files unless they are necessary.
- Explain important changes when working with me.

## HTML

- Use semantic HTML5 elements where appropriate.
- Keep the HTML structure readable and properly indented.
- Preserve existing IDs and classes unless changing them is necessary.
- Use meaningful `alt` text for informative images.
- Do not change existing links, contact information, or page sections unless I explicitly ask.

## CSS

- Prefer the existing CSS structure and styles.
- Reuse existing classes and rules where practical.
- Avoid unnecessary duplication.
- Do not introduce a CSS framework unless I explicitly ask for one.
- Do not make visual changes unrelated to my request.

## JavaScript

- Prefer simple, readable vanilla JavaScript.
- Do not add a JavaScript library when the functionality can reasonably be implemented with existing code or vanilla JavaScript.
- Keep JavaScript changes limited to what is necessary for the requested task.
- Explain non-obvious JavaScript changes.

## Git

- Do not create Git commits unless I explicitly ask.
- Do not push changes to a remote repository unless I explicitly ask.
- Do not reset, revert, delete, or rewrite Git history without first explaining what the command will do.
- Before suggesting a destructive Git command, explain its effect and the files or commits it may affect.
